quiz.prompt: The model visits the website itself.
quiz.why: It writes a note. An ordinary program visits the site and pastes back what it found.

quiz.prompt: A tool request is text the model writes.
quiz.why: It's guessed one token at a time, like any other words, in a shape a program can read.

quiz.prompt: While the tool runs, the model waits and keeps thinking.
quiz.why: It isn't running. When the result comes back, it's run again and rereads the whole conversation.

quiz.prompt: The program that runs the tool is the same AI, thinking harder.
quiz.why: It's usually ordinary code. Some tools use other models, but not the one you're talking to.

quiz.prompt: A search tool searches the model's training text.
quiz.why: It searches pages someone stored on purpose. The model keeps no copy of what it trained on.

quiz.prompt: A pasted result can still be wrong.
quiz.why: If the search grabs the wrong page, the model guesses from it just as smoothly.
